api_for_interop_psd.construct: let mut eng = WideEngine::new(actor.clone(), 8)?;   // cache of up to 8 plans per engine, keep one engine per caller context
api_for_interop_psd.inspect: eng.inspect_profile(ProfileInput { profile_id, bytes, expected_sha256: profile_hash(bytes) }, &cancel) -> WideProfileDescriptor { kind, device (Gray|Rgb|Cmyk), pcs, version_major, device_to_pcs/pcs_to_device intent tables, media_white, bytes }
api_for_interop_psd.cmyk_to_working_rgb: eng.transform(&WideTransformRequest { source: WideSource::Profile(cmyk_input), destination: working_rgb_input, pixels: &interleaved_cmyk_f32, intent, black_point_compensation, revision, expected_revision, correlation_id, resource_id, actor }, &cancel, &mut sink)
api_for_interop_psd.lab: same call with source: WideSource::Lab and pixels = L (0..100), a, b (-128..128) triples; no profile
api_for_interop_psd.gray: source Profile with a Gray kTRC profile, pixels = 1 channel 0..1
api_for_interop_psd.pixels: interleaved f32. CMYK is ink coverage (1.0 = full ink, ICC convention); PSD raw CMYK channels are commonly stored inverted, the caller converts. Lab 8-bit PSD data must be decoded to float L/a/b by the caller
api_for_interop_psd.output: WideTransformResult { pixels (interleaved destination channels, UNCLAMPED for matrix/TRC destinations: out-of-gamut values go below 0 / above 1, e.g. SWOP cyan -> sRGB R about -2.4), receipt, delivery, diagnostic_state }; read receipt.clip (method LinearDevice, pixels_clipped, channels_clipped, max_overshoot) and clamp or gamut-map before display
api_for_interop_psd.errors: WideFailure { error: WideError (code() stable snake_case), operation_error, delivery, diagnostic_state }; numeric output is withheld when delivery fails
api_for_interop_psd.limits: <= 2,097,152 pixels per request; profile <= 2 MiB; first call per key bakes the LUT (about 0.2-0.5 s for CMYK), later calls reuse the plan
